hero.subtitle: A biology-track student who reads cells the way others read stories, writes a little code on the side, and is curious whether dentistry is where precision meets biology.

about.lead: I'm Roham, a biology-track student in Tehran — Biology is where I spend most of my attention: how cells organize themselves, how genetics quietly writes the instructions for everything alive.
about.detail: Outside of biology, I've been teaching myself programming, mostly because I like the same thing about code that I like about biology: small, precise rules producing something much bigger than themselves. I'm also increasingly interested in dentistry — a field that sits right at the intersection of biological knowledge and exact, hands-on craft. I'm based in Tehran for now, though I'm keeping an open mind about studying abroad down the line.

biography.pageIntro: A longer, slower version of my story than the homepage has room for — organized like case files. Pick a folder. (Still writing...)

topic1.title: Where it started
topic1.body: I grew up in Tehran, and for as long as I can remember I've been the kind of kid who takes things apart to see how they work — not always successfully putting them back together. That habit turned out to be good training for biology: living things are also systems you take apart, piece by piece, to understand.

topic2.title: Joining the study track
topic2.body: I'm a student in Iran's NODET (SAMPAD) system, on the biology track — a national program for students who want to go deep into science earlier than a normal curriculum allows. It's demanding, but it's the first place I was surrounded by people who cared about the same things I did.

card1.title: Biology
card1.description: Cell biology, genetics, and the logic living systems run on. My main field of study, and the lens I use for almost everything else.

card2.title: Programming
card2.description: Learning to build things with code — still early, but drawn to it for the same reason as biology: small rules, big results.

card3.title: Dentistry
card3.description: A growing interest — biological knowledge applied by hand, with precision and care. One of the paths I'm considering seriously.

item1.title: Now
item1.description: Studying on the biology track at NODET (SAMPAD) in Tehran.

item2.title: Alongside
item2.description: Teaching myself the basics of programming, project by project.

item3.title: Considering
item3.description: Dentistry as a field where biology becomes something you do with your hands.

item4.title: Ahead
item4.description: Staying open to studying abroad as the next step, wherever it leads.

contact.description: Open to conversations about biology, code, dentistry, or where those three overlap.
